questions.q: if I feed it [1, 2, 3,] where does the leftover comma actually get rejected?
questions.why: end_seq and end_map raise ErrorCode::TrailingComma when a ',' is followed by the closing bracket

questions.q: is there a cap on how deeply nested my input can be, and can I lift it?
questions.why: Deserializer starts with remaining_depth: 128, a check_recursion! macro decrements it, and disable_recursion_limit() turns the check off

questions.q: when my struct has #[serde(deny_unknown_fields)] off and I skip over a huge nested blob, does the skipping itself recurse?
questions.why: the value-skipping routine keeps an explicit stack of '[' / '{' frames in self.scratch rather than calling itself

questions.q: if I iterate concatenated JSON documents out of one buffer, how does it decide where one bare number ends and the next value begins?
questions.why: StreamDeserializer marks '[', '"', '{' as self-delimiting and otherwise peeks for whitespace/punctuation, erroring with TrailingCharacters

questions.q: does it accept a number written with a leading zero like 0123, and where is that decided?
questions.why: parse_integer and scan_integer128 both allow one '0' then error InvalidNumber if another digit follows

questions.q: what code stitches a \uD83D \uDE00 escape pair back into a single emoji character?
questions.why: parse_unicode_escape detects a leading surrogate, requires the trailing one, and combines them before pushing the codepoint

questions.q: when does parsing hand me back a &str that points straight into my input instead of allocating a new String?
questions.why: SliceRead's string parsing returns Reference::Borrowed as a slice of the raw input when no escape has forced use of the scratch buffer

questions.q: which characters does the writer turn into backslash escapes when it emits a string?
questions.why: the ESCAPE 256-byte lookup table plus the CharEscape enum drive escaping of quote, backslash and all control bytes below 0x20

questions.q: can I make the pretty output use four spaces or tabs instead of the default?
questions.why: PrettyFormatter::with_indent takes the indent bytes, and the free `indent` helper writes them current_indent times

questions.q: will serializing a HashMap<u32, T> fail because JSON keys must be strings?
questions.why: both MapKeySerializers stringify integer/bool/char keys (floats only if finite) and return key_must_be_a_string for compound keys

questions.q: if a parsed number overflows what i64 can hold, what does it end up stored as internally?
questions.why: the private N enum has PosInt(u64) / NegInt(i64) / Float(f64) variants and is_i64/as_u64 pick between them

questions.q: Value implements Hash - what does it do about floats, and do 0.0 and -0.0 hash alike?
questions.why: N's manual Hash impl hashes f64::to_bits but substitutes the +0.0 bits whenever the value compares equal to zero

questions.q: how do I get objects to come back out in the order they appeared in the document?
questions.why: the preserve_order cfg swaps MapImpl from BTreeMap to indexmap::IndexMap, which also gates shift_remove/swap_remove/sort_keys

questions.q: is there a built-in way to fetch a value at a path like /foo/0/bar without chaining gets?
questions.why: pointer/pointer_mut split on '/', un-escape ~1 and ~0, and try_fold through objects and array indices

questions.q: why doesn't data["nope"] panic when the key isn't there, but data[3] on an array does?
questions.why: ops::Index falls back to a static NULL Value, while index_or_insert (used by IndexMut) panics for out-of-range array indices and auto-inserts null for object keys

questions.q: what happens if I shove an f64 NaN or infinity into a Value?
questions.why: From<f32>/From<f64> map through Number::from_f64/from_f32, which return None unless finite, so the Value becomes Null

questions.q: deserializing into HashMap<u32, T> from an already-built Value, how do the string keys get back to being numbers?
questions.why: MapKeyDeserializer's deserialize_numeric_key macro re-runs the JSON number parser over the key string for the integer/float methods

questions.q: what is the type that lets me keep a chunk of JSON unparsed actually holding under the hood?
questions.why: RawValue is #[repr(transparent)] over a str with transmute-based from_borrowed/from_owned constructors and NULL/TRUE/FALSE consts

questions.q: there's a feature about exact float round-tripping - what parser does it switch to?
questions.why: de.rs has two f64_from_parts bodies; the float_roundtrip one calls lexical's parse_concise_float / parse_truncated_float instead of multiplying by a POW10 table

questions.q: how can I tell a malformed-JSON failure apart from a wrong-type failure at runtime?
questions.why: Error::classify returns the Category enum (Io/Syntax/Data/Eof) with is_syntax/is_data/is_eof helpers, and From<Error> for io::Error maps them to InvalidData vs UnexpectedEof
